answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation system anchored to a unique digital identity, tied to a proof-of-work (PoW) requirement. Each agent is assigned a distinct, violet-hued digital certificate, analogous to an opal token, which demands significant computational resources to replicate. As an attacker attempts to create multiple fake identities, they become entangled in a spiral of escalating computational costs, making it economically infeasible to launch a Sybil attack, thereby securing the network.
